name: MentionBeacon
description: Passive mention + voice-call capture for the desktop Discord widget. Subscribes to MESSAGE_CREATE / voice dispatches the client already receives and mirrors a rolling 3-day mentions feed plus live VC speaking state to ~/.cache/discord-pulse/. Zero network surface: no REST calls, no sending, no forced fetches — observation only (see docs/SPEC-mention-beacon.md ban-safety doctrine).
author: Matthew Thompson
